name: rive
title: Rive
responsibility: Interactive runtime animations — state-machine-driven graphics that respond to user interaction or app state. Animation that LISTENS.
reachFor: Animations that respond to user interaction (hover, click, drag) or state
State-based product animations authored in the Rive editor
avoid: One-shot decorative loops — that is Lottie's job (see lottie/)
Animations achievable with CSS/motion — no runtime needed then
reactWiring: useRive({ src }) + useStateMachineInput for state machines; rive.play()/pause()/fire(); cleanup automatic
